newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat down in harvest trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat down in harvest trade.

text.p: Argentine wheat slipped in cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange at midsession, with hearty harvest supply weighing down on prices, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for spot Bahia Blanca wheat lost $1 to $136. April maize was unchanged at $98, with the market sustained by lack of supply despite excellent harvest prospects. May soybeans were steady at $250 and March sunflower seed steady at $215 in slow trade in a market devoid of novelty.
